profile.tech_transfer: UC Berkeley Intellectual Property & Industry Research Alliances (IPIRA)
profile.summary: Berkeley is the home of Jennifer Doudna's CRISPR-Cas9 work, and its Innovative Genomics Institute has produced a large group of gene-editing companies, from Caribou and Intellia to Mammoth and Scribe. Labs in chemistry, molecular biology and chemical engineering have also spun out synthetic-biology, protein-degradation and gene-therapy companies; IPIRA counts more than 310 startups built on licensed Berkeley IP.
